newsitem.title: INDIA: India Reliance's share transfer agents.
newsitem.headline: India Reliance's share transfer agents.

text.p: India's Reliance Industries Ltd and Reliance Petroleum Ltd have appointed new registrars and share transfer agents with immediate effect, a company statement said on Wednesday.
Karvy Consultants Ltd with offices in 58 cities across India will service the two companies' nine million shareholders, the statement said.

"The Reliance group has become the first major Indian group to implement SEBI's (Securities and Exchange Board of India) thinking that companies should have an arms length relationship with its R&T (registrar and transfer) agents," it said.

Market regulator SEBI had ordered the suspension of Reliance Consultancy Services Ltd, Reliance's transfer agents, for six months beginning February 1, 1997 for what is said were improper share swaps.
The suspension came into force on March 4 after an appeal by Reliance against the suspension was turned down by the finance ministry.
Reliance Industries is a petrochemicals giant and India's biggest private sector firm.
Share transfers of Reliance's overseas investors in its global depositary receipts and foreign currency convertible bonds are handled by Bank of New York, the statement said.
The Chase Manhattan Bank and Bankers Trust Company are the transfer agents for Reliance's other international bonds, it added.
